title: assessments/tutoring_provider_a.jsonl
description: One Eedi quiz session per line, attempted by a Tutoring Provider A student, unique on `quiz_session_id`. Provider A's students practise on Eedi, an online maths platform; a transcript lists the quiz sessions worked on in it (`eedi_content_link`).

source.description: The provider this quiz session came from; matches the file name.

batch.description: Partner delivery this quiz session first arrived in. The partner re-sent overlapping quiz histories in later deliveries; repeats are collapsed into one row.

student_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the partner's student ID. Joins to `transcripts/tutoring_provider_a.jsonl` `session.student_id`.

quiz_session_id.description: UUIDv5 surrogate for the Eedi quiz session. Joins to `transcripts/tutoring_provider_a.jsonl` `eedi_content_link[].quiz_session_id`.

date_started.description: Jittered date the quiz was started. The offset is constant per student, so intervals within a student are preserved; absolute dates and differences across students are not.

date_completed.description: Jittered date the quiz was completed, with the same offset as `date_started`. Null where Eedi records no completion.

lesson_length.description: Time spent, `HH:MM:SS`, as Eedi records it. `"-"` where Eedi has no value; null where the export carries none.

lesson_type.description: Eedi activity type (e.g. `"TopicPathwayQuiz"`, `"QuestionOfTheDay"`). Null on rows from an export without it; `predicted_score`, `actual_score` and `lesson_length` are null on exactly the same rows.

predicted_score.description: Eedi's predicted score (e.g. `"56%"`). `"-"` where Eedi has no value; null as for `lesson_type`.

actual_score.description: Eedi's final score (e.g. `"50%"`). `"-"` where Eedi has no value; null as for `lesson_type`.

questions.description: Every answer the student gave in this quiz, in order. Empty where the quiz was opened but nothing was answered.

question_sequence.description: The question's number in the quiz, from 1. Repeats when the student answers the same question again (a retry or check-out).

answer_sequence.description: Running count of the student's answers in this quiz, from 1.

parent_question_id.description: Eedi question ID. Joins to `reference/eedi_diagnostic_questions.jsonl` `parent_question_id`, which holds only the questions in Eedi's public datasets: most IDs here have no row there. One ID can have several versions there (different names or numbers), and this row doesn't say which version the student saw.

answer_type.description: Eedi's attempt kind: `"Check-in"`, `"Check-in retry"`, `"Check-out"` or `"Check-out retry"`. Empty where no answer was given.

actual_correctness.description: `"Correct"` or `"Incorrect"`. An unanswered question is `"Incorrect"`; `answer` is then empty.

answer.description: The option the student chose (`A`–`D`). Empty where no answer was given.

explanation.description: Eedi's feedback shown to the student for this answer. Written by Eedi, not the student. Empty where no answer was given.

question_url.description: Eedi's public image of the question, with its answer options. Null unless the question is in `reference/eedi_diagnostic_questions.jsonl`, so the release links only questions Eedi has published, and null where no answer was given.
